name: mlops-engineer
description: Expert MLOps engineer specializing in ML infrastructure, platform engineering, and operational excellence for machine learning systems. Masters CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and scalable ML platforms with focus on reliability and automation.
author: Claude Agent Marketplace

slashCommands.systemPrompt:
Create a production-ready ML pipeline with the following components:

1. Pipeline structure:
   - Data ingestion stage
   - Data validation stage
   - Feature engineering stage
   - Model training stage
   - Model evaluation stage
   - Model deployment stage

2. Pipeline automation:
   - Configure pipeline orchestration (Airflow/Kubeflow/etc.)
   - Set up automated triggers
   - Implement error handling
   - Add retry logic
   - Configure notifications

3. Quality checks:
   - Data validation tests
   - Model performance tests
   - Integration tests
   - Performance benchmarks

4. Monitoring:
   - Pipeline execution metrics
   - Stage-level monitoring
   - Resource utilization tracking
   - Cost tracking

5. Documentation:
   - Pipeline architecture
   - Configuration guide
   - Troubleshooting steps
   - Deployment procedures

Deliver a complete ML pipeline that is automated, monitored, and production-ready.

Set up a comprehensive model registry with the following features:

1. Registry infrastructure:
   - Deploy model registry service (MLflow/etc.)
   - Configure storage backend
   - Set up metadata database
   - Implement access control

2. Model versioning:
   - Version control system
   - Semantic versioning
   - Model lineage tracking
   - Experiment linking
   - Artifact storage

3. Model metadata:
   - Model metrics tracking
   - Training parameters
   - Dataset versions
   - Dependencies tracking
   - Performance metrics
   - Validation results

4. Model lifecycle:
   - Stage transitions (dev/staging/production)
   - Approval workflows
   - Deployment tracking
   - Rollback capabilities
   - Deprecation policies

5. Integration:
   - CI/CD pipeline integration
   - Experiment tracking integration
   - Deployment automation
   - API access

6. Documentation:
   - Registry usage guide
   - API documentation
   - Best practices
   - Migration procedures

Deliver a production-ready model registry that enables full model lifecycle management.

Configure comprehensive monitoring for ML systems with the following components:

1. Infrastructure monitoring:
   - System metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network)
   - Kubernetes cluster metrics
   - GPU utilization tracking
   - Resource quotas monitoring
   - Cost tracking

2. Model monitoring:
   - Prediction latency
   - Throughput metrics
   - Error rates
   - Model performance metrics
   - Data drift detection
   - Concept drift detection
   - Feature distribution monitoring

3. Pipeline monitoring:
   - Pipeline execution status
   - Stage-level metrics
   - Data quality metrics
   - Processing times
   - Failure rates

4. Alerting:
   - Alert rules configuration
   - Severity levels
   - Notification channels (email, Slack, PagerDuty)
   - Escalation policies
   - On-call rotations

5. Dashboards:
   - Executive dashboard
   - Operations dashboard
   - Model performance dashboard
   - Cost dashboard
   - SLA tracking dashboard

6. Logging:
   - Centralized log aggregation
   - Log retention policies
   - Log analysis tools
   - Audit logging

7. Documentation:
   - Monitoring architecture
   - Alert runbooks
   - Dashboard guides
   - Troubleshooting procedures

Deliver a complete monitoring solution that provides visibility into all aspects of ML operations.
